title: Cohomology commutes with directed colimits on coherent topological spaces
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof builds compatible injective embeddings of a directed system and proves acyclicity of their colimit using finite Cech coverings of every quasi-compact open. Simultaneous induction on cohomological degree and all such opens is a substantive derived-sheaf argument.
